summary: Tests-only phase for issue #39. Committed: (1) the solver parity corpus (byte-identical copy of viamin/color_matching priv/parity/v1/corpus.json, algorithm_version 1, sha256 7b7b4d904ff369e1f5be0ec3a994d96cc996056e856d86a2b764b83c050f8604) as a test fixture with SolverParityCorpusTests driving all 12 scenarios through both WeightedSquaredErrorScorer and the CompositionSolver fast path (per-candidate score tables, exclusions, zero-weight optionality, unknown weight keys, earliest-index-wins ties); (2) OpenAPIContractTests, an intentionally red guard that fails until the OpenAPI document from viamin/color_matching#110 is committed under ColorComposerCore/OpenAPI/; (3) PaletteAPIClientTests wire-conct tests pinning the /api/v1 HTTP contract that must survive the swift-openapi-generator migration; (4) docs/parity-corpus.md and docs/generated-openapi-client.md (corpus refresh procedure + acceptance-criteria verification map). bin/lint passed (exit 0; Swift build/tests skipped by design because this container has no Swift toolchain — macOS/CI must run swift test). Parity semantics were cross-validated by an IEEE-754 binary64 simulation of the Swift scorer against every corpus scenario: all 12 pass exactly, ties bit-exact. No implementation files were touched (test-phase allowlist honored).
